thread:
Rina (Marketing): Quick workshop notes: finalizing hero copy + launch playbook for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Need distinct messaging lanes (PLG vs enterprise), exact CTA text, and inbound routing rules for lead qualification. Also planning a short launch post and webinar tie-in.
Tom (Product): Focus on clarity for engineers and infra owners. Avoid fluff. One headline should call out latency/cost tradeoffs without numbers.
Priya (Design): I'll draft three hero treatments per page (feature-led, benefit-led, trust-led). Mobile-first. Can someone confirm badge list for Private (SOC2, KMS)?
Marco (Growth): I recommend: Hosted = PLG primary, Dedicated = mixed self-serve + AE, Private = AE only. We'll gate AE CTAs with company size and intent signals.
Leo (Eng): Routing is doable. We can use signup metadata and inbound hidden fields to send to HubSpot pipelines. We'll emit event `site_hero_cta` with properties: product, variant, campaign.
BenchBot: SEO tips: keep H1 < 65 chars, include "inference" and one deployment term per page.
Rina (Marketing): HOSTED — H1 candidates (pick two for A/B):
1) "Production hosted API for inference, ready at scale"
2) "Turn prompts into product features with low-latency hosted inference"
3) "Hosted inference with streaming, tools, and usage controls"
Priya (Design): 2 is very action-focused. My vote: A/B 1 vs 2 with 3 as the control for docs/secondary pages.
Tom (Product): Microline under H1: "Start with free credits. Stream responses, function calls, and model routing." Keep it short.
Rina (Marketing): DEDICATED — H1 candidates:
1) "Reserved GPU lanes for predictable inference throughput"
2) "Dedicated inference capacity with SLA-backed performance"
3) "Commit capacity, control latency and unit cost"
Marco (Growth): CTA split test idea: primary CTA = "Reserve capacity" (AE path), alt CTA = "Estimate throughput" (self-serve calc). I'll measure lead quality by qualification score.
Leo (Eng): If AE path is chosen, include fields: expected qps, sequence length, preferred model family, and compliance needs. Prefill model family from route param when possible.
Rina (Marketing): PRIVATE — H1 candidates:
1) "Private deployment: VPC or on-prem inference"
2) "Keep inference where your data lives  enterprise controls and auditability"
3) "Air-gapped and auditable serving for regulated workloads"
Tom (Product): Use variant 2 for product pages and 3 for industry/regulatory pages. Add badges: SOC2, KMS/HSM, VPC.
Priya (Design): I'll include a small compliance badge cluster under the hero for Private.
Rina (Marketing): CTA matrix proposal:
- Hosted: Primary "Start building  free credits" (self-serve). Secondary "See benchmarks" (anchor)
- Dedicated: Primary "Reserve capacity" (AE). Secondary "Run capacity estimate" (self-serve).
- Private: Primary "Arrange private demo" (AE). Secondary "Security docs" (link).
Marco (Growth): Gate AE CTAs: show AE for companies with >50 employees OR > $1M ARR (we have signals from signup). Else show self-serve. AE submissions go to HubSpot pipeline `site-hero-ae` with tags [product:dedicated|private].
Leo (Eng): We'll include an attribution param campaign=hero-launch and source=website. Fallback: AE form emails go to sales@redwood.ai if HubSpot is down.
Rina (Marketing): Webinar placement: add a thin strip under Hosted hero: "Webinar: Building reliable LLM features with Redwood  May 10" CTA "Register". For Dedicated, add an inline CTA: "Deep dive webinar for infra teams"  links to recorded session and signup.
BenchBot: Suggested launch post outline: 1) Problem statement (serving pain), 2) How Redwood solves it across Hosted/Dedicated/Private, 3) benchmark highlights (link to full report), 4) call to action + webinar. Keep it ~700-900 words.
Tom (Product): On benchmarks: we can publish latency and cost curves for two representative model families on N1 and N2 configs. Use conservative wording: "representative workloads" and avoid one-off claims. Legal has to review.
Rina (Marketing): Measurement & A/B plan: run Hosted hero A/B for 10 days, metrics: signup rate, webinar CTR, time-on-page, bounce. For Dedicated/Private measure AE form rate and SQL conversion. Marco will set up tracking.
Marco (Growth): I'll create campaign in HubSpot and GA. Naming: campaign=hero-launch-2026, variant=A/B in utm_content.
Priya (Design): I'll post 3 Figma frames per page in the figma thread and label each with variant IDs (H1-A, H1-B, H1-C). Expect link by EOD.
Rina (Marketing): Content tasks: 1) finalize hero microcopy + CTAs (owner: me) 2) publish launch post + benchmark page (owner: Tom) 3) wire HubSpot flows and forms (owner: Marco) 4) design assets (owner: Priya) 5) infra hooks (owner: Leo). Due dates: draft by Wed, publish next Tue.
Leo (Eng): We'll add `site_hero_cta` event and map HubSpot fields. ETA: 48 hours.
Marco (Growth): For inbound scoring: AE leads get priority if they select Dedicated or Private and provide qps. I'll add a playbook for SDRs.
Rina (Marketing): Legal note: avoid numeric speed claims. Tom to share approved benchmark phrasing by EOD.
Tom (Product): Will share approved lines and the benchmark report link.
Rina (Marketing): Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate this into a short playbook and post the doc + Figma link once Priya shares. Follow-up thread after A/B results. :white_check_mark:
